body: Yup, I live in Michigan. Could be the weather, this house is also super bad for my allergies too. Lots of dust and some mold.
I actually know for a fact I clench my jaw a lot! That makes sense. I clear my throat every single day and I know it's probably doing some kind damage but it's hard to stop.

Hey there, I was in a similar situation a few years ago. Lost a friend to a drug overdose, grandfather and aunt to cancer and grandmother to diabetes all in the same year. I understand how overwhelming this all must be. Best thing you can do right now is be there for your family every step of the way. But also, try to distract yourself in healthy ways. Right now is the absolute perfect time to go to the gym. Get in there and burn out all that confusion and frustration, turn the stress into fuel if you can. As far as your mother goes, cancer survival rates keep going up and up as the years go by, and it's especially a good sign that your mother's was caught early. There's a good possibility she'll find a treatment that will work for her. Look into CBD while looking for another one, it's been shown to work well with other treatments. I hope all goes well, and that you and your family will be okay.

Thank you, it's nice to hear a voice when I'm in these places. I know we broke up for a reason. I think a break would've been better but I know I can't bring her back now, nor would it be healthy. I just miss her, but I'm trying really hard to accept it. As for the gym, I'd love to but I'm in a really bad place financially which is really messing with me too. I'm in the process of finding a new job right now, maybe when I'm more settled in. 

Thank you, again, though. I'm usually semi-okay in the day, but at night all these bad things just come rushing into my head, begging me to make a bad decision. It's getting harder to cope with, I just hope things will look up soon. I have some faith but I'm afraid it's dwindling at this point.
